purpose: Make cross-representation state-information comparisons on one common response-blind state cohort, avoiding candidate-specific adversarial-pair selection as a ranking confounder.

prior_exposure.firewall: The common-cohort pair universe, radii, output metrics, aggregation and interpretation rules below are frozen before any cross-candidate pair response outside the original P2 frozen pair manifests is computed.
prior_exposure.forbidden: No common-cohort pair may be added, removed or weighted based on its future-response difference.

cohort.source: exact 41 unique start states in the formal P2 selection artifact
cohort.pair_universe: all unordered cross-history pairs among those 41 states
cohort.rationale: The 41-state cohort is response-blind but candidate-enriched because it is the union of formal P1 adversarial pair endpoints. It is suitable for fair within-cohort comparison, not for a population-wide probability claim.

state_distance.coordinate: fixed-layer mean theta, information-equivalent to layer storage for fixed thickness
state_distance.role: diagnostic neighborhood only, never an application acceptance tolerance

future_response_source.execution: reuse the already completed formal P2 Reference trajectories for each of the 41 starts

for_each_representation_and_radius: maximum response difference for every primary purpose component
median and 95th percentile magnitude for cumulative exchange and storage components
aggregation.monotonicity_check: As the diagnostic radius increases, close-pair count must be nondecreasing; maximum ambiguity components must be nondecreasing up to numerical equality because each larger-radius set contains the smaller-radius set.
aggregation.zero_pair_rule: If a representation has zero close pairs at a radius, report NO_ALIAS_IN_COMMON_COHORT rather than zero hydrological ambiguity.

comparison_rule.common_pair_advantage: At a fixed diagnostic radius, representation A has common-cohort ambiguity dominance over B only when A has no greater close-pair count and no worse value on every declared purpose component, with at least one strict improvement.
comparison_rule.dimension_interpretation: A lower-dimensional representation may remain scientifically interesting even without dominance if it meets a later external application envelope at materially lower computational state dimension.
comparison_rule.application_acceptance: Still not adjudicated in P2C; absolute tolerances must remain externally sourced.

expected_scientific_questions: Does U4's small one-day ambiguity persist when tested on the same state-pair cohort as D2-D4?
Does D3 preserve the nearest-future response structure of D4 despite one fewer state?
Do uniform controls create more hidden aliases with sign/reversal consequences than active-zone-refined states?
At what state radius does purpose-relevant ambiguity begin to grow sharply for each representation?

pre_execution_alias_clarification.primary_alias_definition: full-state-diagnostic pair AND candidate reduced-state L_inf <= radius_multiplier * diagnostic_floor
pre_execution_alias_clarification.full_state_near_identical_pairs: reported separately as a baseline and excluded from reduction-induced alias response summaries
pre_execution_alias_clarification.rationale: Preserves the formal P1 distinction between intrinsic Reference-scale state indistinguishability and information loss introduced by projection.
pre_execution_alias_clarification.scientific_effect: No pair is selected or excluded using future response; the rule depends only on already frozen full and reduced state geometry.
